findings.title: Historical failed-v1 negative-control fixture is a sixth runtime dependency omitted from inputs
findings.evidence: BUILD.run_negative_controls.nc_j reads failed FEVA v1 RECORDS directly without a PINS entry. Read trace and three isolated dependency probes confirm it. Missing file aborts with FileNotFoundError; replacing it with CORR1 aborts with NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FAILURE; truncating invalid fixture to baseline length changes NCJ diagnostic and manifest while canonical RECORDS remain byte-identical.
findings.causalConsequence: full-package reproduction requires the separately identified historical fixture; main is not hermetic over the five declared pins alone. The fixture cannot supply analytical values and its absence or a valid-baseline substitution blocks publication.
